    user_id: str,
    payload: TelemetryEventPayload,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):

    current_span.set_attribute("app.user_id", user_id)
    current_span.set_attribute("app.event_name", payload.event_name)
    current_span.add_event("client_activity", {"details": payload.details})

diagnosis: The endpoint accepts user_id in the URL path and records custom OpenTelemetry span events and telemetry logs attributed to that user_id. It fails to check current_user.id == user_id, allowing users to inject fabricated tracking events and tamper with user activity metrics of other accounts.

corrected_code:
@router.post("/telemetry/users/{user_id}/event")
async def log_user_telemetry_event(
    user_id: str,
    payload: TelemetryEventPayload,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if str(current_user.id) != user_id and not current_user.is_telemetry_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: cannot record telemetry events for another user")

    current_span = trace.get_current_span()
    current_span.set_attribute("app.user_id", str(current_user.id))
    current_span.set_attribute("app.event_name", payload.event_name)
    current_span.add_event("client_activity", {"details": payload.details})

    await log_telemetry_to_store(user_id=str(current_user.id), event=payload.event_name, data=payload.details)
    return {"status": "event_recorded", "user_id": str(current_user.id)}
